Asset type: transparent full-body landmark sprite for the established Canran learning journey.
Input roles: Image 1 is the accepted map visual master for palette, compact proportions and finish ONLY. Image 2 is the accepted first-lesson sprite for warm brown outlines, rounded approximately three-head-tall adults, softly modeled matte colors and clean alpha edges. Image 3 is this lesson's keepsake identity/story reference. Image 4, when present, specifies complete clothing and footwear, not its taller proportions.

Canvas: square, approximately 1254×1254; keep 10–12% transparent margin on EVERY side including beneath all shoes. Shrink the whole illustration if needed; never cut off feet. NO floor, platform, cast ground shadow, surrounding glow, colored fog, opaque matte, checkerboard, background, text, UI, stars, medal, logo or watermark. Do not copy Image 1's UI or the first lesson's faces/outfits.
Primary request: the happy ending of Lesson 19, a mother caring for her two children after receiving their ice creams. Exactly THREE people, full-body STANDING group. Mother LEFT: dark-brown curly shoulder-length hair, small round gold earrings, coral jacket over pale-yellow top, cuffed blue trousers and cream lace-up sneakers, as Image 4. Girl CENTER: dark-brown twin pigtails with yellow ties, yellow short-sleeved dress with ivory rounded collar, white socks and yellow strap shoes. Boy RIGHT: brown tousled hair, teal/light-teal striped T-shirt, blue shorts, white socks and teal sneakers. Mother smiles warmly toward them, one open hand near the children. Each child holds ONE pink ice-cream cone with both hands or one hand; TWO cones total, none for mother. Children clearly shorter than mother. No vendor, no bench, no extra cones or food, no money or shopping bags. Preserve the existing family identities, including mother's trousers rather than a skirt. Keep children separated enough that their cones and shoes remain individually readable.
